terms.definition: The smallest particle of an element that still behaves like that element.
terms.function: The building block of molecules, compounds, and all matter.
terms.whereItIs: The whole nucleus-plus-cloud structure in the model.
terms.whyItMatters: Everything in the universe is built from atoms.

terms.definition: The dense core of the atom, packed with protons and neutrons.
terms.function: Holds nearly all the atom's mass and its positive charge.
terms.whereItIs: The small bundle at the center of the model.
terms.whyItMatters: The nucleus gives the atom its identity and weight.

terms.definition: The region around the nucleus where electrons orbit.
terms.function: Holds the electrons in shells, in the atom's mostly-empty space.
terms.whereItIs: The large translucent sphere in the model.
terms.whyItMatters: The electrons in the cloud are what drive chemistry.

terms.definition: Two or more atoms held together by chemical bonds.
terms.function: What atoms build when they bond together.
terms.whereItIs: The two bonded atoms in the build-a-molecule layer.
terms.whyItMatters: Molecules are how atoms combine into everything.
